svg.text: ExpressRoute Failover Across Two Virtual WAN Hubs
Two Megaport circuits · hubRoutingPreference = ASPath · hub-to-hub transit · GCP on-premises simulator advertising 10.0.0.0/8
Each hub prefers its local circuit. When one circuit drops, 10.0.0.0/8 is relearned over hub-to-hub transit with a longer AS path, and ASPath routing preference installs it.
